FORM 10-K — ACME INDUSTRIAL CORP

ITEM 1.   BUSINESS

Acme Industrial Corp designs, manufactures, and services engineered machinery. TOC-SENTINEL-BUSINESS marks the real Business section body in this fixture.

ITEM 1A.    RISK FACTORS

TOC-SENTINEL-RISK marks the real Risk Factors body. Our results depend heavily on capital spending by a small number of large logistics customers, and a deferral of automation projects by any one of them would materially reduce our order backlog and operating income.

We rely on a limited number of suppliers for precision motion components and semiconductors. Extended lead times or allocation decisions by those suppliers have in the past delayed shipments, and a recurrence could increase costs and delay revenue recognition.

Item 3 - legal proceedings

TOC-SENTINEL-LEGAL marks the real Legal Proceedings body. We are party to routine litigation incidental to our business.

ITEM  7.   MANAGEMENT’S DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS OF FINANCIAL CONDITION AND RESULTS OF OPERATIONS

TOC-SENTINEL-MDA marks the real MD&A body in this fixture. Revenue increased 6.9% to $6.20 billion in fiscal 2025 and operating margin expanded 90 basis points to 19.7%.
